channel.description: Recent content in Tsc on Radin Reth

item.title: CamWallet v2: A Closed Ledger With No Bank in the Path
item.description: How CamWallet’s second version changed two assumptions, who decides eligibility and where payment happens, and why everything else in the design follows from those two changes.

item.title: CamWallet: What Two Retrospectives Taught Me About Building With an Agent Loop
item.description: CamWallet’s v2 epics were built with an unattended AI agent loop. Two retrospectives showed the same pattern each time: the loop built too much, a human review cut it back, and the history recorded both.

item.title: ESB-MOT: One Restaurant Licence, Five Services
item.description: Tracing a single restaurant licence application through the Ministry of Tourism’s ESB platform, from a Nuxt form to a signed PDF, across five Spring Boot services and two Kafka hops.

item.title: ESB-MOT: Testing a Platform Spread Across Twenty Repos
item.description: MOT had no tests running in CI, and the defects that reached dev clustered at the boundaries between services. Notes on re-verifying a stale bug ledger, a stale department header, and a testing strategy built around where defects actually land.

item.title: Re-engineering the KAS Platform — Phase 1
item.description: Notes from four months re-architecting SAAMBAT/KAS at TSC: replacing the gateway, dropping internal E2EE, consolidating IAM, standardizing observability, and putting Kafka in the middle.
